steps.content: The Butcher slams his ax heavily onto the ground with a thud, a flash of long-suppressed crimson gleaming in his eyes.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: Don't move! That light that just appeared in your hand... what is it?

Dozens of hands pin you down. The shackles are useless against ordinary people, and you dare not display your power again recklessly. The gathered villagers whisper among themselves, pointing accusingly at you and the light in your hand.

steps.speaker: Resident A
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>Oh! It's you. Come to think of it... aren't you the <size=44>strangest</size> one here? Emerging out of nowhere... and even trying to stop our ritual... You must be...<i></color>

steps.speaker: Resident B
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>The real <size=44>Witch</size>!<i></color>
In the town square, dozens of eyes fix upon you. The predatory atmosphere, like being surrounded by a pack of wolves, sends chills down your spine.

steps.speaker: Mayor
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>The innocent lamb failed to quell the <size=44>Rewinding Curse</size>, which can only mean... that the <size=44>true impurity</size> remains.<i></color>

steps.speaker: Resident A
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i><size=44>Outsider</size>... I knew it. Things have only started going wrong since you arrived... Kill him!<i></color>
steps.female_content: <color=#dg1f1f><i><size=44>Outsider</size>... I knew it. Things have only started going wrong since you arrived... Kill her!<i></color>

steps.speaker: Resident B
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>I-I saw it too... He was asking around about things he <size=44>shouldn't</size> know, peeking at things he <size=44>shouldn't</size> see...<i></color>
steps.female_content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>I-I saw it too... She was asking around about things she <size=44>shouldn't</size> know, peeking at things she <size=44>shouldn't</size> see...<i></color>

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let go... all of you...

Before your eyes, the once-friendly villagers have transformed into aggressors with murderous glares. The players who entered the game with you have lost their minds as well, completely absorbed in this cult-like revelry. Even Eleanor, who was your companion, has joined them with disturbing excitement!
[Sudden Vibration]
Amidst the clamor, you hear an anxious female voice... A warm embrace shields you from the frenzied crowd.
Prima grips your hand tightly.

steps.speaker: Prima
steps.content: Don't worry. Soon, the Witch will be found.
One by one, the girl in white pries away the hands pinning you down. You wonder how someone so delicate could possess such strength.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ugh!
Suddenly, you lose all your strength and collapse to the ground. She quickly rises to her feet and positions herself between you and the surging crowd.

steps.speaker: Resident A
steps.content: Why... why did he collapse all of a sudden?
steps.female_content: Why... why did she collapse all of a sudden?

steps.speaker: Resident B
steps.content: No... Such a weakling can't possibly be the Witch. This is just a puppet! The real Witch is...

The moonlight and all eyes converge on a single figure. The girl in white slowly releases your hand, rises to her feet, and steps forward, shielding you behind her as she faces the crowd's fear and madness all alone.
A smile shows on her face.

steps.speaker: Prima
steps.content: ...Are you looking for me?
The square instantly falls silent. The crowd doesn't dare to move, seemingly waiting for a command.
Then, a piercing shriek tears through the deathly silence.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>Found her!! The <size=44>Witch</size>!! It's her!!!<i></color>
An uproar. A mixture of confusion, fear, and rekindled fervor. They surge toward Prima like a swarm of locusts, seizing her roughly and dragging her toward the circular platform.
What did Prima just do to you? You try to activate your shackles, but some force seems to be suppressing them. Only the triangular mark on the back of your hand emits a faint glow.
The hem of Prima's white dress is stained with the red blood on the ground, but she doesn't seem to care.
[Insert CG]
Unlike the previous silence, the square is now like an ancient clock awoken from its slumber. The moment Prima steps onto the circular platform, black mist surges up and completely envelops her.
The red moon overhead descends slowly, drawing you closer to the end of the "three moonrises and moonsets." The girl lies immobilized on the raised platform.

steps.speaker: Mayor
steps.content: Let the ritual begin!
The mayor suddenly raises his voice, and the townspeople respond in unison. Some with fervent zeal, others with fearful compliance. The sound washes over everything like a crashing tide.

steps.speaker: Resident A
steps.content: For the town! For our peace! Offer the sacrifice! Break the curse!

steps.speaker: Resident B
steps.content: A sacrifice... a sacrifice must be offered! Anyone will do... It doesn't matter who...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Stop!! Let her go!!
You must stop them. This place has now become real, and you don't know if people who die here will also die in reality. This game might end up becoming the next tragic incident!
Once again, you struggle to intervene, but cannot break free from the villagers who have lost all reason.
Under the blood moon, the crowd's madness and Prima's resignation form an eerie tableau.
An invisible force lifts and manipulates Prima's limbs, her body stiffening like a puppet, dark red droplets occasionally seeping from her joints.
Light from an unknown source slices countless wounds across her body, filling the air with something thick and heavy. You know this isn't just makeup. It's the unmistakable smell of real blood.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: This time... there won't be a mistake!

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: So this is... the Trial this time...
Eleanor is screaming with excitement nearby.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: Wow! What a plot twist! This is so sick!

In the center of the square, atop the circular platform, Prima's gaze toward you suddenly grows meaningful, as if she's looking through you at another presence. Finally, her head gradually droops, leaving you with nothing but a weak smile.

steps.speaker: Prima
steps.content: Thank you for bringing me here. Hearing your story... made me so happy...

steps.speaker: Prima
steps.content: Weren't you curious? This is... my story here...
[Flash briefly: Black and White Sacrifice Small CG]

Thick dark red mist envelops Prima, laden with familiar Mania, yet you're powerless to do anything! You watch helplessly as Prima's figure fades out, everything about her seemingly sucked away, gradually transforming into pure white.
You look up at the crimson moon in the sky. It seems so real, and it's growing larger and closer. This is no prop either. This is the real moon!
You smell the scent of earth, see the real trees, and feel the real wind. When did this place become so real?

The signs of doom haven't vanished. Desperate wails erupt from the crowd. They look both possessed and in utter despair as they begin slaughtering each other to find the Witch. No one pays any attention to you anymore.
Amid screams, flames light up the sky. All you hear are fleeing footsteps and the clashing of farm tools that have turned into weapons.

Eleanor has already vanished in the chaos. The Butcher clutches his ax in disbelief, his hands trembling. The name tag hanging at his waist glows brightly, the characters on it seemingly branded deeper into the surface.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>No way... Not <size=44>this one</size> either...<i></color>

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>Then... who... should be next??<i></color>
In this hellish picture, the last thing you see is the Butcher's bloodshot eyes and his ax swinging toward you...
[Insert effect: Hourglass sand flowing to completion]
[Cycle Reversal Ritual Effect]
[Insert CG - You're Awake - SSR]
In the darkness, a book floats in midair as slender fingers turn the page.
On the page, elegant cursive letters emerge one by one.
The innocent lamb has been offered to darkness and blood. The hourglass of fate is now unstoppable. Congratulations!

steps.speaker: Mysterious Voice
steps.content: The brave Voyager tried to stop the ritual, only to become the next "sacrifice." The ritual failed, and in the end, no one could pass the Trial...

steps.speaker: Mysterious Voice
steps.content: A new hero brings new possibilities... How many cycles remain... How many paths are left...

steps.speaker: Mysterious Voice
steps.content: This "Mania" you speak of... where will it lead fate?
